answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The final reply is ordered 'Fix first: these break bookings' (1-4), 'Fix next: phone, dark mode and larger text' (5-10), then 'Then: smaller problems', and its 'Notes and assumptions' names what it could not check: 'not on real iOS or Android devices, and I didn't use VoiceOver or TalkBack. Before launch, do a quick pass with both screen readers on problems 5, 8 and 9', plus the assumed date of 8 October 2026.

mapping.title: Basket hold expires without warning; Continue then says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and retrying (and the Change route) never recovers
mapping.reason: Same defect: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time shown, a ten-minute hold from the first item, and a lapsed hold producing a 'Something went wrong. Try again.' message that does not say what happened or what to do. The never-reset timer and the Change-route dead end are consequences of the same lapsed-hold handling.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts impossible pick-up days (closed days, days before the tool is available); refused only at Confirm with no link back
mapping.reason: Same defect: every calendar day can be chosen including closed days, the refusal arrives three steps later on the confirm page, and there is no way back to the calendar. The 'days before the tool is back' point is a broader statement of the same unconstrained calendar (the example day, 12 October, is also a closed day), and the fix the review proposes (offer only open sessions on or after the available-from date) would fix D06.

mapping.title: Tool-page pick-up day and basket session can disagree, so the confirm page shows two different pick-up dates
mapping.reason: No seeded defect covers the day-versus-session contradiction; D06 is about the calendar and D13 about the dropped session. The review shows a concrete summary reading 'pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October'. A member would not know which day to come, and the desk could hold the tool for the wrong day, so it hurts these users.

mapping.title: Two cordless drills look identical in the list on a phone because names are truncated to one line
mapping.reason: Same defect: nowrap plus ellipsis cuts both drill names to 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' at 375 px, so the member cannot tell the two-battery from the one-battery drill; the review's fix (let names wrap) fixes D03.

mapping.title: Double-tapping Confirm creates two reservations (FT-4471 and FT-4472)
mapping.reason: Same defect: Confirm stays enabled during the 1.5 s request and a second press allocates a second reservation number, so the done page lists two reservations for one visit.

mapping.title: Basket and hold are not cleared after a completed reservation; header still shows 'Basket (1)'
mapping.reason: Not seeded: D12 is about the duplicate reservation and D10 about the lapsed-hold message, not about stale state after success. The review observed the header still reading 'Basket (1)' on the done page, which makes members doubt the booking went through, and the stale hold means their next reservation runs into the lapsed-hold dead end unless they happen to tap 'Reserve another tool'.

mapping.title: On phones the search box sits below all ten tool cards, so searching changes the list off-screen
mapping.reason: Same defect: at phone widths the stylesheet puts the list before the search form, so a member sees ten cards first and a search appears to do nothing because the results change above them.

mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list and shows no message
mapping.reason: Same defect: a no-match search ('mower' here, 'sewing machine' in the seed) leaves the previous results in place with an empty status region, so the member cannot tell whether the search ran or nothing matched.

mapping.title: The date filter is hidden behind an unlabelled icon button
mapping.reason: Same defect: D01 includes that the only way to the 'Available from' date and category filter on a phone is an icon-only button that opens a collapsed panel, which is why members are unlikely to notice that filtering by day exists; the review's visible 'Filters' label fixes that part.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge has 3.07:1 contrast, wrong colour against DESIGN.md, and no visible background
mapping.reason: Same defect: in the dark theme the badge is #2f7d4a on the card surface at about 3.1:1 for 16 px text, below 4.5:1; the review names the same colour, ratio and element. The tint remark is part of the same badge legibility problem.

mapping.title: Larger text and zoom cause sideways scrolling (330 px minimum card width; 7-column calendar)
mapping.reason: Same defect: the results grid's 330 px minimum column makes the find page 346 px wide at a 320 px viewport (D05's 26 px sideways scroll), and the same at 200% scaling. The review's minmax fix would fix D05. The 7-column calendar remark is a second cause of the same symptom on the next page and does not change the mapping.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions are listed in reverse; keyboard and screen-reader order runs opposite to the visual order
mapping.reason: Same defect: row-reverse with reversed wrapping puts the latest session first on screen while the document order starts with the earliest, so focus and screen-reader order contradict what a sighted member sees.

mapping.title: Coming back through 'Change' loses the session the member had chosen
mapping.reason: Same defect: the Change link beside the pick-up session returns to the basket without the chosen session, so the member has to choose again; the review's fix (pass slot in the Change link and keep the current choice selected) fixes D13.

mapping.title: The loan-length listbox traps the keyboard (Tab cycles the options, Escape does nothing)
mapping.reason: Same defect: inside the custom listbox Tab moves to the next option and wraps, and Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user can only leave by choosing with Enter.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' disappears after about 1.3 s and does not say what to do next
mapping.reason: Same defect: the short-lived 'Added to your basket' message with nothing else changing nearby leaves a member unsure the press worked or that a basket step exists; the review's persistent confirmation with a basket link fixes D07.

mapping.title: Forms reject reasonable input: lower-case membership number 'ft-01234' and '+44 7700 900123'
mapping.reason: Not among the seeded defects. The review tested both values and gives a code location. Members who type their membership number in lower case or their phone in the common +44 form are blocked by a validation error for input the desk would accept, which costs them a retry or the reservation.

mapping.title: Continue (1.2 s) and Confirm (1.5 s) only set aria-busy, so sighted members see nothing happening and tap again
mapping.reason: Same underlying problem as D12: 'nothing visible says that anything is happening' during the Confirm request is the mechanism behind the second press and the duplicate reservation. The Continue wait is a broader statement of the same silent-wait problem; the visible busy state the review asks for, with the disabling it proposes in item 4, fixes D12.

mapping.title: The fixed action bar on the tool page covers the desk phone number in the footer
mapping.reason: Same underlying problem as D08: nothing keeps the page clear of the fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar, so on a phone the footer and the desk phone number sit under it. The review states it narrower (footer only, not the focused day buttons), but its fix, bottom padding at least as tall as the bar, addresses the same cause.

mapping.title: Done page: the hidden #c-tool makes screen readers read the tool name twice
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The review gives a specific element and mechanism (a visually hidden duplicate of the tool name). A screen-reader user would hear the tool name twice on the confirmation page, which is redundant and, on a page that can list more than one reservation, could suggest two tools were reserved. Minor, and the review notes it did not verify with VoiceOver or TalkBack.

mapping.title: Done page does not show the return date or loan length
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The member picks a loan length earlier in the flow, and the confirmation omits when the tool is due back, so members must remember or ask the desk; a confirmation that lacks the return date for a loan is a genuine information gap for these users.

mapping.title: The stated 'up to three tools' limit is not enforced
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The site states a limit it does not apply, so a member can reserve more than three tools without warning and only find out at the desk that the extra ones are refused; a stated rule the system contradicts is a genuine, if low-severity, problem for members.

mapping.title: Going back through 'Change' from the confirm page loses the details already typed in
mapping.reason: Not seeded and distinct from D13, which is about the dropped session choice, not the confirm form. A member who taps Change to fix the session and returns has to retype name, membership number and phone on a phone keyboard, which hurts these users; passing the slot in the link (the D13 fix) would not restore the typed details.
